card.name: Inside Chinese names and decimal numbers
card.fires_on: Characters of Chinese personal names written in Chinese script inside author credits, and the decimal point or digits inside numbers in tables. Also occasionally partway through a drug or mutation name.

modes.label: Chinese name characters
modes.description: Chinese characters of a person's name inside parentheses beside the romanized name.

modes.label: Decimal points in tables
modes.description: The decimal point or digit within a number in a lab or trial data table.

card.writes: Little clear effect; it mildly promotes small articles like 'the' and 'a' and some Chinese phrases.
card.plain: It fires inside Chinese names in author lists and inside decimal numbers in data tables.
